name: Doosan Fuel Cell Co., Ltd.
summary: Doosan Fuel Cell Co., Ltd. develops and distributes power generation fuel cells in South Korea. The company supplies fuel cell to produce stationery fuel cells. It also offers 400 NG, a fuel cell which supplies natural gas. In addition, the company provides M400, hydrogen energy solution provider. Doosan Fuel Cell Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Iksan-si, South Korea.
